description: This file defines a PHP class for searching and modifying XML documents using XPath expressions, with support for XPath axes, functions, and operators. It includes parsing, node navigation, and XML export functionalities. The classes XPathBase and XPathEngine implement core XPath processing and XML document manipulation features.

classes.name: XPathBase
classes.description: Provides core helper functions, error handling, debugging, and general utilities for XPath processing.

classes.name: XPathEngine
classes.description: Extends XPathBase to implement XPath parsing, node indexing, XML import/export, and document manipulation functionalities.

classes.name: XPath
classes.description: Extends XPathEngine to provide additional functionality such as XPath query resolution, node modification, and advanced XPath-related operations.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Retrieves a node in the internal index based on an absolute XPath.

methods.name: wholeText
methods.description: Returns the concatenated text content of a node or a specific text part, or retrieves attribute values based on XPath.

methods.name: exportAsHtml
methods.description: Exports the current XML document or a node as HTML with optional highlighting.

methods.name: exportAsXml
methods.description: Exports the current XML document or a node as raw XML string.

methods.name: exportToFile
methods.description: Exports the XML document to a specified file, with file locking support.

methods.name: importFromFile
methods.description: Reads an XML file or URL, parses it, and stores into internal structure.

methods.name: importFromString
methods.description: Parses an XML string, with optional parent node path for appending data.

methods.name: _handleStartElement
methods.description: Handles opening XML tags during parsing, adding nodes to the document tree.

methods.name: _handleEndElement
methods.description: Handles closing XML tags during parsing, closing nodes in the document tree.

methods.name: _handleCharacterData
methods.description: Handles character data while parsing, appending text to nodes.

methods.name: _handleDefaultData
methods.description: Default handler for miscellaneous data during XML parsing.

methods.name: _handlePI
methods.description: Handles XML processing instructions during parsing.

methods.name: _createSuperRoot
methods.description: Creates a super root node as the top of the document tree.

methods.name: _internalAppendChild
methods.description: Adds a new child node to the internal document tree during XML parsing.

methods.name: reindexNodeTree
methods.description: Rebuilds the internal index of nodes for efficient XPath querying.

methods.name: _recursiveReindexNodeTree
methods.description: Recursive helper to update node index and tree structure, including attributes and text parts.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Evaluates an XPath query, returning matching nodes, booleans, numbers, or strings.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Alias for match() method.

methods.name: _evaluateExpr
methods.description: Recursive evaluation of XPath expressions, handling operators, path expressions, and primary expressions.

methods.name: _evaluatePrimaryExpr
methods.description: Evaluates primary XPath expressions such as literals, variables, functions, and parenthesized expressions.

methods.name: _removeLiterals
methods.description: Extracts and replaces string literals in XPath expressions with references for parsing.

methods.name: _asLiteral
methods.description: Returns a string as a literal reference if it is a stored literal.

methods.name: _addLiteral
methods.description: Stores a literal string in an array and returns its reference.

methods.name: _GetOperator
methods.description: Detects operators in XPath expressions, parsing operands and operators.

methods.name: _evaluatePrimaryExpr
methods.description: Evaluates primary XPath expressions including variables, literals, function calls, and parenthesized expressions.

methods.name: _evaluatePathExpr
methods.description: Evaluates XPath path expressions (not fully detailed here but integral to matching nodes).

methods.name: _evaluateFunction
methods.description: Evaluates XPath functions like count(), string(), number(), etc. (not detailed here but invoked in main evaluation.)

methods.name: _evaluateOperator
methods.description: Performs comparison and arithmetic operations based on operator and operand types.

methods.name: _stringValue
methods.description: Converts a node or node set to its string value.

methods.name: _handleFunction_boolean
methods.description: Converts various XPath objects to boolean for comparisons.

methods.name: _printContext
methods.description: Utility to print evaluation context details (for debugging).

methods.name: _displayError
methods.description: Handles error messaging and logging.

methods.name: _beginDebugFunction
methods.description: Sets up debugging for a specific evaluation function.

methods.name: _closeDebugFunction
methods.description: Ends debugging block, optionally outputting debug info.

methods.name: _evaluatePathExpr
methods.description: Evaluates XPath path expressions, handling different path syntax including relative and absolute paths.

methods.name: _sortByDocOrder
methods.description: Sorts an XPath node set by document order based on internal node index positions.

methods.name: _evaluateStep
methods.description: Evaluates a sequence of XPath steps starting from a given context, handling axes, node tests, predicates, and recursion for subsequent steps.

methods.name: _checkPredicates
methods.description: Filters nodes based on predicate expressions, evaluating each predicate in context.

methods.name: _evaluateFunction
methods.description: Evaluates XPath functions (e.g., last, position, count, id, name, string, concat, starts-with, contains, substring-before, substring-after, substring, string-length).

methods.name: _checkNodeTest
methods.description: Checks whether a specific node matches a given node-test, handling wildcard, name, function, and specific node types.

methods.name: _getAxis
methods.description: Parses a step of an XPath expression to extract axis, node-test, and predicates.

methods.name: _handleAxis_child
methods.description: Handles the 'child' axis, retrieving child nodes of a given context path.

methods.name: _handleAxis_parent
methods.description: Handles the 'parent' axis, retrieving the parent node of a given context path.

methods.name: _handleAxis_attribute
methods.description: Handles the 'attribute' axis, retrieving attributes of a node.

methods.name: _handleAxis_self
methods.description: Handles the 'self' axis, returning the context node if it matches.

methods.name: _handleAxis_descendant
methods.description: Handles the 'descendant' axis, retrieving all descendant nodes recursively.

methods.name: _handleAxis_ancestor
methods.description: Handles the 'ancestor' axis, retrieving all ancestor nodes.

methods.name: _handleAxis_namespace
methods.description: Handles the 'namespace' axis (not supported, reports error).

methods.name: _handleAxis_following
methods.description: Handles the 'following' axis, retrieving nodes that follow the context node in document order.

methods.name: _handleAxis_preceding
methods.description: Handles the 'preceding' axis, retrieving nodes that precede the context node.

methods.name: _handleAxis_following_sibling
methods.description: Handles 'following-sibling' axis, getting all siblings after the context node.

methods.name: _handleAxis_preceding_sibling
methods.description: Handles 'preceding-sibling' axis, getting all siblings before the context node.

methods.name: _handleAxis_descendant_or_self
methods.description: Handles 'descendant-or-self' axis, combining self and descendant nodes.

methods.name: _handleAxis_ancestor_or_self
methods.description: Handles 'ancestor-or-self' axis, combining ancestor and self nodes.

methods.name: _handleFunction_last
methods.description: Handles the XPath 'last()' function, returning the size of current context.

methods.name: _handleFunction_position
methods.description: Handles the 'position()' function, returning position within context.

methods.name: _handleFunction_count
methods.description: Handles 'count()' function, counting nodes in a node-set.

methods.name: _handleFunction_id
methods.description: Handles 'id()' function, retrieving nodes with given IDs.

methods.name: _handleFunction_name
methods.description: Handles 'name()' function, returning the name of a node.

methods.name: _handleFunction_string
methods.description: Handles 'string()' function, converting nodes/nodelists to string.

methods.name: _handleFunction_concat
methods.description: Handles 'concat()' function, concatenating string arguments.

methods.name: _handleFunction_starts_with
methods.description: Handles 'starts-with()' function, checking prefix.

methods.name: _handleFunction_contains
methods.description: Handles 'contains()' function, substring search.

methods.name: _handleFunction_substring_before
methods.description: Handles 'substring-before()' function.

methods.name: _handleFunction_substring_after
methods.description: Handles 'substring-after()' function.

methods.name: _handleFunction_substring
methods.description: Handles 'substring()' function.

methods.name: _handleFunction_string-length
methods.description: Handles 'string-length()' function.

methods.name: _handleFunction_x_lower
methods.description: Handles custom XPath extension function for converting a string to lowercase.

methods.name: _handleFunction_x_upper
methods.description: Handles custom XPath extension function for converting a string to uppercase.

methods.name: _handleFunction_generate_id
methods.description: Handles 'generate-id()' XPath function, producing a unique id for nodes.

methods.name: decodeEntities
methods.description: Decodes or encodes HTML entities within strings or arrays, acting as a utility for entity handling.

methods.name: equalNodes
methods.description: Compares two nodes (by absolute XPath or node array) for identity, considering them equal if their XPath matches.

methods.name: getNodePath
methods.description: Returns the absolute XPath of a given node, constructing it from parent nodes if needed.

methods.name: getParentXPath
methods.description: Extracts the parent XPath from a given absolute XPath.

methods.name: hasChildNodes
methods.description: Checks if a node (by XPath) has child nodes, based on internal index.

methods.name: _translateAmpersand
methods.description: Handles encoding or decoding of ampersand entities in XML sources, to manage entity problems during parsing.

methods.name: _translateAmpersand
methods.description: Handles encoding or decoding of ampersand entities in XML sources, to manage entity problems during parsing.
